chapter: Chano Pozo, Town Hall and Charlie Parker
title: Miguelito introduces Chano; Cachao and Pepe Beque hired as dancers
summary: Miguelito introduced the Blen Blen composer, the crowd went wild, and Cachao and Pepe Beque were hired to dance nightly.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: How did he get to do it? Did somebody introduce him?
Yeah, Miguelito Valdes.
Miguelito introduced him that night?
Yeah
What do you remember about that?
Oh! the people, they went crazy.
Well, no, yeah, when Miguelito - what did he say? I have somebody here from Cuba or something like that?
Yeah, "I have somebody here, the composer of "Blen Blen" and "Arinanara" and all those numbers that he recorded. The people know him about the nunmbers that he wrote.
And did he invite Chano up to the stage?
To the stage and he just everybody flipped.
Okay, he sat Pepe in a chair, took a tablecloth, put it around Pepe"s neck and make believe that he was the barber cutting Beque's Hair?
and dancing around Pepe Beque.
and dancing around him?
III - 140
around Beque.
To what, to what tune?
To "Bongo Arrollador".
Ah - ha, and how long did that last?
Whoosh! half an hour, because Pepe Beque - and then he just stand up and start dancing and ....
He started dancing with Him?
.... and Cachao, dancing, because the team was Cachao and Pepe Beque.
They were the dancers.
They were the dancers.
I see.
Oh!! They were tremendous.
The three of them were dancing on stage?
Yes; and Miguelito and Diosa and Bobby Capo. It was a - I am telling you - something to see, beautiful.
Uh - huh, and how many other times did Chano go to the Conga?
Well, as a matter of fact, Pepe Beque and Cachao was hired to dance up there. They used to go practically every night.
Well, they were hired, but not him?
No, because he wasn't in condition for dancing and do anything.....
I see.
... so they hired Pepe Beque and Cachao.
